# Red Flag AI Pro

## What it is
Red Flag AI Pro does two things. It checks marketing copy, sales pages, email sequences, VSL scripts and ads for compliance risk against 30 risk categories across 10 jurisdictions, in plain English, with rewrite suggestions for every issue found. Separately it scores AI governance across six dimensions and produces an audit ready evidence record, so a business can prove to a board, an insurer or a regulator how its AI is governed rather than simply asserting it.

## What problem it solves
Compliance is where you get caught. Governance is why you got caught.

Most compliance failures are not intentional. Businesses copy what everyone else is doing without knowing it breaks the law, and by the time a regulator publishes a ruling the evidence is public and permanent. The governance problem is different. Organisations have policies but cannot show what actually happened, who signed off, or when. A policy describes intent. It is not evidence that anything was enforced.

## Who it is for
- Marketing agencies writing copy for clients
- Course creators, coaches and funnel builders
- Ecommerce and consumer brands making product, health or sustainability claims
- Law firms and chambers advertising regulated services
- FCA regulated businesses publishing financial promotions
- CFOs, non executive directors and compliance teams who need documented AI governance
- Any business preparing for EU AI Act obligations

## Compliance checking
- 30 risk categories checked at once
- 10 jurisdictions: UK, USA, EU, Canada, Australia, Singapore, UAE, South Africa, India, Nigeria
- Plain English explanation of every issue found
- Compliant rewrite suggestions included
- 0 to 100 compliance score
- Page and URL checking, YouTube VSL transcripts, audio transcription, full site audits
- Weekly automated monitoring
- White label reports and client workspaces for agencies

## AI governance scoring
- Six scored dimensions: strategy and decision rights, tools and data, policy, monitoring and outcome accountability, vendor risk, regulatory readiness
- 0 to 100 governance maturity score with peer benchmarking
- Named top critical gap, mapped to the relevant regulation
- Audit ready evidence package: scored assessment, risk register and 90 day roadmap
- Role and mandate stamped sign off records, so a decision record shows the authority the signer held at that moment
- Tamper evident audit trail carrying independent RFC 3161 timestamps
- Public verification page where any sealed record can be checked by a third party without an account

## Honest limits
Red Flag AI Pro can show that a record existed at a given time, was not backdated, and who signed it. It cannot prove that the named person genuinely applied judgement. No system can, and any vendor claiming otherwise is overstating what is possible.

Red Flag AI Pro is not a law firm, is not regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority, and does not provide legal advice.

## Regulations and frameworks covered
FTC, FDA, CAN SPAM, FTC Negative Option Rule, FTC Endorsement Guides, CMA, ASA, CAP Code, BCAP Code, ICO, FCA, FSMA 2000, CMA Green Claims Code, UK GDPR, DUAA, GDPR, UCPD, DSA, EU AI Act, EU Green Claims Directive, EU Product Liability Directive, PECR, DORA, SEC, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OECD AI Principles, ACCC, ACL, TGA, CASL, PIPEDA, Competition Bureau, Munir v SSHD

## EU AI Act, 2 August 2026
From 2 August 2026 the enforcement and penalty provisions of the EU AI Act switch on, including fines of up to 3 percent of global turnover or 15 million euros for general purpose AI obligations. Article 50 transparency duties and Article 4 AI literacy duties already applied before that date. High risk system obligations were delayed to December 2027. Red Flag AI Pro checks for disclosure and transparency issues on every check and scores readiness as part of the governance assessment.
